title: WeMacro Bluetooth FOCUSER_STEPS stays BUSY after a disconnect during a move
description: In indigo_mac_drivers/focuser_wemacro_bt/indigo_focuser_wemacro_bt.m the didDisconnectPeripheral callback (reached on Bluetooth link loss and on a CONNECTION disconnect) does not end a FOCUSER_STEPS move that is in INDIGO_BUSY_STATE. FOCUSER_STEPS is completed only by a 0xf5/0xf6 notification from the rail, which can no longer arrive, so the property stays BUSY across the disconnect and reconnect. The FOCUSER_STEPS change handler starts a move only when the state is not BUSY, so every later move request is silently ignored until FOCUSER_ABORT_MOTION sets ALERT. Expected: a disconnect while FOCUSER_STEPS is BUSY ends the move with INDIGO_ALERT_STATE (as was done for X_RAIL_EXECUTE in ticket a2513f61-8af8-4ff2-a950-7bf0658d19a0 and as the portable sibling indigo_drivers/focuser_wemacro does), and a move requested after reconnect is accepted. Add hardware-free regression coverage in indigo_test/unit/test_focuser_wemacro_bt.py and increment DRIVER_VERSION. Found by the reviewer of ticket a2513f61 as a pre-existing, out-of-scope issue; not measured on the physical rail.
